rows.quote: We screened 2408 phenotypes from 44 categories in the Finnish database (R10 version), which comprised 412,181 individuals.
rows.coder_note: The sentence gives the release as 'R10 version' (rule A) together with 412,181 individuals, the exact N of FinnGen R10; the other passage also says 'Version R10' and nothing conflicts.

Table 1 gives eight accessions under this name. Four (ebi-a-GCST90018864, GCST90018926, GCST90018890, GCST90018806; sources UK Biobank and FinnGen) lie inside the registered range of the Sakaue 2021 BBJ row but are stated as European with N about 484,000, which that row does not allow (rule I3). The other four (GCST90038689, GCST90013864, GCST90038608, GCST008403; source UK Biobank) are in no dictionary row (rule B). No single row is identified.
